study type: Observational, comparative, descriptive and retrospective study
exposure: Mode of conception (assisted reproduction vs natural)
Number of fetuses (more than two vs not)
cohort: 184 children from multiple pregnancies born at the Centro Medico Nacional '20 de Noviembre' del Instituto de Seguridad y Servicios Sociales de los Trabajadores del Estado between June 2008 and June 2016
finding: The study did not find a significant difference in the risk of retinopathy of prematurity between multiples conceived naturally and those conceived via assisted reproduction.
gest_age: Group 1 (assisted reproduction): 32.7 weeks +/- 2.12 weeks; Group 2 (natural conception): 32.9 weeks +/- 2.17 weeks
